text:
Decomposed 2026-05-11 by do-beads loop into 5 sub-beads:

* PKIX-amgn.5.1 — Decide pkix-lint-cabf no_std posture + Cargo.toml setup. (Design decision: flip to std; recommendation documented in bead.)
* PKIX-amgn.5.2 — Move cabf_tls_br.rs from pkix-lint to pkix-lint-cabf. Mechanical. Depends on .5.1.
* PKIX-amgn.5.3 — Move CABF integration tests + resolve OSCAL fixture-test policy. (Design decision: option (ii) rewrite framework tests with Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint + inline MinimalLint; rejected (i) move framework tests downstream and (iii) dev-deps escape hatch. Recommendation documented in bead.) Depends on .5.2.
* PKIX-amgn.5.4 — README + rustdoc reframe. Depends on .5.2; can run in parallel with .5.3.
* PKIX-amgn.5.5 — Version bumps + CHANGELOG. Depends on .5.2; can run in parallel with .5.3 and .5.4.

Two design decisions need human sign-off before the autonomous loop proceeds on .5.1 and .5.3:

1. (.5.1) Confirm pkix-lint-cabf flips from #![no_std] to std. Recommendation: flip. The stub's no_std attribute was aspirational; the cabf_tls_br code uses std::sync::OnceLock and std::error::Error and there is no consumer use case for no_std CABF lints in scope.

2. (.5.3) Confirm fixture-test policy option (ii). Six framework unit tests in pkix-lint/src/oscal/{catalog,profile}.rs use crate::cabf_tls_br::all_lints() as multi-lint fixtures. After the move that import breaks. Option (ii) rewrites those tests to use Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint + a synthetic inline MinimalLint where the test needs >1 distinct lint type. Architecturally clean; ~30 LOC of test rewrites. Option (iii) adds pkix-lint-cabf as a dev-dependency of pkix-lint (reverse-direction edge at test-time only, not a real cycle) which is the cheapest in code-change terms but couples framework tests to the downstream crate. Rejected (i) move framework tests to pkix-lint-cabf — framework tests should live with the framework.

Surveyed by explore subagent (2026-05-11). Full survey covers: current cabf_tls_br.rs contents (8 pub items, 685 LOC, 3 private DER helpers), pkix-lint-cabf stub state (85 LOC, 0 functional Rust), all workspace cross-references (only pkix-lint's own tests and OSCAL fixture tests reference cabf_tls_br — favourable case), README and rustdoc audit (full file:line refs in sub-bead descriptions), and CHANGELOG entry locations.

Umbrella PKIX-amgn.5 stays open until all 5 children close. Children PKIX-amgn.5.1 and PKIX-amgn.5.3 also need approval (or split: label .5.1/.5.3 individually if approval is partial).
